title: Better Pillager Patrols
description: Configure all pillager patrol spawn parameters!
body:
**Highly recommended with [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu/versions?g=1.21.11&l=fabric)**

Allows you to configure everything: patrol group sizes, spawn frequency, detection ranges, and spawn distances. 

Patrols no longer care about villages or light levels — they'll hunt you anywhere. Increase the radius pillagers spread across, fine-tune how far they need to be to provoke, and push them further from your position. Make your world feel more dangerous.

All settings are configurable in-game via Mod Menu for quick tweaking without restarting.

Also pairs nicely with my other mod: [Point Blank Pillagers](https://modrinth.com/mod/point-blank-pillagers)

**NOTE: SETTING THE TICK RATES TO 0 AND/OR CRANKING THE GROUP SIZE ALL THE WAY UP WILL FLOOD YOUR WORLD WITH PILLAGERS CAUSING SEVERE LAG. PLEASE USE THIS MOD CAREFULLY.**
